title: SDV_googleColab
summary: A pair of Google Colab notebooks demonstrating SDV's single-table synthesizer on the California housing dataset and a generic table example, including metadata detection, synthesis, and quality evaluation. The notebooks directly run SDV's CTGANSynthesizer along with its diagnostic and quality-evaluation utilities.
evidence: Test_SDV_on_californiaHousing_train_data.ipynb:41-46: imports CTGANSynthesizer, SingleTableMetadata, run_diagnostic, evaluate_quality and fits/evaluates on real data
